convergence_study.interpretation: complex_rel_max p≈1.82; first-row p≈0.78. Sub-first-order convergence confirms wall Stokes-layer under-resolution. At H=87 the first fluid row falls below the 10% u_peak mask threshold (first_row=2.07% but excluded from gated metric), so complex_rel_max drops to 0.57%.

wall_correction.key_finding: BFL interpolated bounce-back with q=0.45 (wall shifted from y=0.5 to y=0.45) reduces complex_rel_max from 4.89% to 2.67%, passing the 3% gate. NEQ extrapolation (linear/quadratic) destabilizes the solution (70-83% error). BFL q>0.5 worsens error (10-20%), confirming the correction direction.

quantitative_conclusion.note: Convergence order p=1.82 (complex_rel_max), p=0.78 (first-row). Std BB passes at H≥58. BFL q=0.45 wall correction passes at H=29 (2.67%<3%). NEQ extrapolation fails (destabilizes). Extrapolated min H for <3% with std BB: ~42.
